summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of AzoApp. Built pytest suite (83 tests) at /app/backend/tests covering auth (4 roles, OTP), catalog, pricing/quote+coupon, full direct booking lifecycle with commission-split math verification, merchant-assisted booking (shop->start->completion OTP), merchant lifetime referral, wallet, all admin endpoints, AI chat, role guards, and authorization/ownership. Result: 72/83 passed (86.7%). Happy paths and the money flow (partner 374.25 / platform 124.75 / merchant referral 18.71 / merchant_booking 24.95) are mathematically correct and match dynamic admin settings. Frontend: landing, OTP login for all 4 roles, customer dashboard/wallet/referral, service detail + live quote, partner panel (jobs/active/earnings/online toggle), merchant panel (overview/book-for-customer/onboard/network), admin panel (all 9 tabs) all render and integrate correctly; mobile 390px has no overflow. BLOCKERS FOUND: (1) any phone can self-register as role=admin and gets full admin control, (2) no ownership checks on any booking endpoint -> OTP theft + another partner can complete your job and take the money + fake payments/reviews, (3) AI chat is 100% broken from the UI (422 on session_id:null).

critical.issue: PRIVILEGE ESCALATION: any unknown phone + role='admin' auto-creates a real admin account. Verified: random phone -> token -> GET /api/admin/dashboard 200 and PUT /api/admin/settings 200 (could rewrite commission %). Admin (and merchant) roles must never be self-registerable; restrict admin creation to seed/invite and require KYC/approval gate for merchant.

No ownership check (controllers/booking_controller.py:get_booking). Any authenticated user can read ANY booking: customer PII, phone, address and otps.start/otps.completion (OTPs are only blanked for role=='partner'). This defeats the entire 3-way OTP design. Must assert customer_id/partner_id/merchant_id == user id, or role admin.

MONEY FLOW: no check that partner['id'] == booking['partner_id']. Verified partner +919000000005 completed a booking assigned to +919000000003 and the commission ledger paid the wrong partner. Combined with the get_booking leak this is fully exploitable (steal OTPs, then complete + get paid).

No ownership check and no status check: (a) any customer can mark another customer's booking as paid, (b) a booking in status 'assigned' can be paid (verified 200), (c) re-paying is allowed and writes duplicate debit transactions (no idempotency). Restrict to booking.customer_id and status in ('completed',).

No ownership check - any customer can post a review on any booking. Verified: a foreign customer 1-starred Raj Kumar's job; his rating is now 1.0. Also ReviewRequest.rating has no bounds (rating=99 and rating=-5 both return 200), and add_review double-counts: review is $set first, then the aggregate query re-reads it AND appends req.rating again. Add ownership check, Field(ge=1, le=5), and compute the average from stored reviews only.

Feature entirely broken from the UI. routes/ai_routes.py ChatRequest declares 'session_id: str = None' -> Pydantic v2 rejects explicit null with 422. AiChat.jsx always posts session_id: null on the first turn, so every role sees 'Sorry, AI abhi unavailable hai'. Fix: session_id: Optional[str] = None. (Backend works when session_id is omitted - Claude replies fine.)

minor.issue: Accepts negative/zero amount and $inc's the wallet down. Verified amount=-1000 -> balance -1000 and a credit transaction rendered as '+Rs-1,000'. Add Field(gt=0) and a max cap.

Does not verify the partner is in booking['eligible_partner_ids'], so MatchingEngine skill matching is bypassed (verified: a partner with skills ac/electrical/appliance accepted a 'cleaning' job even though it was correctly absent from /partner/jobs). Also non-atomic: the status=='searching' read + separate update allows two partners to both accept; use a conditional update_one({'id':id,'status':'searching'}) and check modified_count.

merchant_partner_referrals.status only ever becomes 'active' if an admin hits the KYC endpoint after onboarding; partners already approved elsewhere stay 'pending_kyc', so merchant_dashboard.active_partners under-reports.

Design/business risk: PricingEngine sets commissionable_base = pre-discount subtotal, so the platform absorbs 100% of any coupon discount. With AZO50 on the Rs499 service, platform keeps 124.75 + 29.98 fees = 154.73 vs a 150 discount; on any cheaper service platform revenue goes negative. Decide whether the discount reduces the commissionable base or is split.

GET /bookings/{booking_id} is declared before GET /bookings/partner/jobs. It currently works (a literal path segment can still match because FastAPI orders by declaration and 'partner' would be captured as booking_id -> 404) - verified partner/jobs returns 200 today, but this ordering is fragile; move the static /partner/jobs route above the dynamic one.

ui_bugs.issue: AI assistant always answers 'Sorry, AI abhi unavailable hai' for customer/partner/merchant/admin because the POST /api/ai/chat request 422s on session_id: null (see backend critical #6). Either fix the backend model or omit session_id when it is null.
Negative amounts render as '+Rs-1,000' in the transaction list and 'Rs-1,000' as Available Balance. Sign should come from txn.type (credit/debit), and negative balances should not be reachable.
'Pay' button is offered on bookings that are still 'assigned' in the backend (the API accepts it), and remains clickable after payment; also 'Rate' has no 1-5 constraint feedback.
Document <title> is still 'Emergent | Fullstack App' instead of AzoApp - visible in browser tab and SEO.

integration_issues.issue: 422 from /api/ai/chat on every first message; the catch block swallows the error so users only see a generic Hindi fallback and no error state distinguishing outage vs bad request.

issues: 'Appliance Repair' category image is a photo of breakfast food/pancakes - completely unrelated to the service; replace it.
Category tiles are heavily desaturated/dark-overlaid making the white label text low-contrast on the lighter images (Home Cleaning).
Rating chip shows a bare '3' / '1' with no /5 denominator, and it is fed by an unvalidated review pipeline.
Success toast prints the Shop OTP in plain text ('Booked AZO90010! Shop OTP: 2053') which auto-dismisses; there is no persistent place for the merchant to re-read the OTP.

action_items: CRITICAL: Block self-registration for role='admin' (and gate 'merchant') in auth_controller.verify_otp; only seeded/invited admins.
CRITICAL: Add ownership authorization to every booking endpoint - get_booking, pay, review (customer_id), start-otp/shop-otp/evidence/complete (partner_id), and merchant reads (merchant_id).
CRITICAL: Fix ai_routes.ChatRequest.session_id to Optional[str] = None so the UI AI chat works.
HIGH: Enforce status transitions - pay only from 'completed', make it idempotent; accept only from 'searching' via conditional update and only for eligible_partner_ids.
HIGH: Validate WalletTopupRequest.amount > 0 and ReviewRequest.rating 1..5; fix add_review double-counting of the new rating.
MEDIUM: Decide coupon-discount bearer (commissionable_base is pre-discount today - platform can go negative).
LOW: Set the page <title> to AzoApp; replace the wrong 'Appliance Repair' category image.
Cleanup: test data left behind - TEST_* coupons, TEST_ Onboarded Partner users, 'New User' customers +9191111000xx, and Raj Kumar's rating is corrupted to 1.0 (re-seed or reset ratings).
critical_code_review_comments: controllers/booking_controller.py has zero authorization logic - every handler takes booking_id and mutates it without comparing the caller to customer_id/partner_id/merchant_id. Introduce one _authorize(user, booking, allowed_roles) helper and call it in all 9 handlers.
get_booking blanks otps only for role=='partner'; blank/whitelist by ownership instead of role, and never return otps.completion to anyone other than the customer.
accept_job's read-then-write is a race (two partners can both accept); use a conditional update_one and assert modified_count == 1.
add_review sets the review then recomputes the average over rows that already include it and appends req.rating a second time - the new rating is counted twice.
PricingEngine.compute sets commissionable_base = subtotal (pre-discount) while total is post-discount; the platform silently funds all coupons.
Money-mutating Pydantic models (WalletTopupRequest.amount, ReviewRequest.rating) have no Field constraints - raw input is trusted.
routes/booking_routes.py declares the dynamic /{booking_id} route before the static /partner/jobs route; reorder to avoid future shadowing.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (all panels/flows render and integrate; AI chat broken, wallet sign-rendering bug)

seed_data_creation: Created via tests: bookings for Priya Verma (direct + merchant-assisted, completed/paid/reviewed), TEST_C##### coupons, 'TEST_ Onboarded Partner' partners under Sharma Electricals, throwaway customers +919111100022/33/44/55, throwaway merchant +919777700011, and a self-registered admin account on a random +9198765##### phone (delete it). Priya's wallet was restored to Rs1000 after the negative-topup test.
test_credentials: Seeded OTP dev-mode accounts from /app/memory/test_credentials.md all work: admin +919000000000, merchant +919000000002, partner +919000000003, partner +919000000005, customer +919000000004; send-otp returns dev_otp, OTP replay correctly rejected (400).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q` (pytest.ini already sets -n 2 --dist loadscope). Suite is class-scoped and order-dependent within classes. The 11 known failures are all real defects, not test bugs: TestBookingOwnership (7), TestDirectBookingFlow::test_12, TestWallet::test_topup_negative_amount_rejected, TestSelfSignupPrivilege::test_random_phone_cannot_self_register_as_admin, TestAIPayloadContract::test_explicit_null_session_id. After the main agent fixes authorization, re-run the whole suite - all 11 should flip green. Frontend data-testids verified: role-{customer|partner|merchant|admin}, login-phone-input, send-otp-button (auto-fills login-otp-input), verify-otp-button; customer nav-orders/nav-wallet/nav-referral/nav-ai, book-new, pay-{CODE}, review-{CODE}, topup-amount/topup-btn; service detail schedule-now/emergency, addr-line/pincode/city, coupon-input, confirm-booking; partner nav-jobs/nav-active/nav-earnings, online-toggle; merchant nav-overview/book/onboard/network, mc-* form (mc-service is a shadcn Select BUTTON, click then pick [role=option]), op-*; admin nav-dashboard/bookings/partners/merchants/customers/commission/coupons/ledger/ai, set-*, save-settings. Note: to switch roles in the UI you must clear localStorage first, otherwise /login redirects to the active panel.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the security cluster: the MVC split put JWT identity resolution in middleware/auth.py (get_current_user / require_role) which only validates the ROLE, and the controllers were written assuming role == authorization. No handler ever compares the authenticated user's id to the booking's customer_id/partner_id/merchant_id, so any valid token of the right role can act on any booking. Reproduce: log in as customer A, create booking, note its id; log in as any other customer -> GET /api/bookings/{id} returns 200 including otps.start/otps.completion; then log in as any other approved partner -> POST /api/bookings/{id}/complete with that OTP returns 200 and CommissionEngine credits that partner's wallet. Root cause of the admin escalation: auth_controller.verify_otp treats the client-supplied 'role' as authoritative and calls build_user(phone, role) for unknown phones, so role is user-controlled. Root cause of the AI outage: FastAPI/Pydantic v2 treats 'session_id: str = None' as a required-typed str with a None default, so an explicit JSON null fails validation with 422 - the frontend always sends null on the first turn.
